findings.detail: Job correctly reads channel_message_template.subject and passes it in message_params to CreateStageAutomationMessage
parse_text correctly substitutes all 7 template variables (SenderFullName, SenderFirstName, JobTitle, CandidateFullName, CandidateFirstName, CandidateLastName, OrganizationName) in the subject field

parse_text returns '' for nil input (line 34: return '' if text.blank?). This produces a blank subject on the saved channel_message, which correctly triggers the mailer fallback (subject.presence || fallback) in ChannelMessageMailer.notify_candidate

Validator on subject field (validates :subject, custom_channel_message: true) correctly rejects messages with unsubstituted {{}} variables. All test messages passed validation because parse_text substituted all variables before save
Subject and body can contain different subsets of template variables and each gets independently substituted by parse_text

ChannelMessageMailer.notify_candidate (line 116) uses: @channel_message.subject.presence || "#{@job.title} at #{@organization.name}". When template subject is nil/empty, parse_text returns '', .presence returns nil, so the fallback fires correctly
